name: E-mail
description: Windows MDM settings in the E-mail category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Add signature to OneNote email messages (User)
properties.description: Checks/Unchecks the option ''Add the following signature to e-mail messages and Web pages created in OneNote''.

properties.name: Allow OneNote e-mail attachments (User)
properties.description: Checks/Unchecks the option ''Attach a copy of the original notes as a OneNote file''.

properties.name: Attach embedded files to the email message as separate files (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to configure the "Attach embedded files to the email message as separate file" option found under File tab | Options | Advanced | E-mail sent from OneNote.

If you enable or do not configure this policy setting, embedded files are attached to the email message as separate files.

If you disable this policy setting, embedded files are not attached to the email message as separate files.

properties.name: Enter signature to use for OneNote e-mail (User)
Prevent Office 365 E-mail accounts from being configured within a simplified Interface (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines whether an Office 365 E-mail account when being configured in Outlook, can use a simplified dialog that can greatly accelerate the initial account creation.

If you enable this policy setting, users will configure their Office 365 accounts using the Account Wizard, as they do, for all other account types.

properties.name: Prevent Outlook from interacting with the account settings detection service (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines whether Outlook can interact with the account settings detection service to gather information about a user's account settings.

If you enable this policy setting, users will need to manually configure their account settings.

properties.name: Prevent saving credentials for Basic Authentication policy (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to prevent Outlook from saving user credentials using Basic Authentication.

If you enable this policy setting, Outlook will not save user credentials using Basic Authentication.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, Outlook will allow the user to save credentials when using Basic Authentication against a server. These credentials are stored as generic and retrievable by any process running with that user's rights on the machine.

properties.name: Specify Offline Address Book path (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to specify a path to save the Offline Address Book. This policy setting will apply to all Microsoft Exchange accounts.

If you enable this policy setting, you may specify a path to save the Offline Address Book.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, Outlook will save the Offline Address Book in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Outlook.

properties.name: Use this signature for OneNote email (User)
properties.description: Sets the value in the option ''Add the following signature to e-mail messages and Web pages created in OneNote''.
